description: This file is a Perl module 'Git::LoadCPAN' which provides a wrapper for dynamically requiring other Perl modules, primarily from CPAN or local fallback copies. It manages loading modules conditionally based on environment variables and defines constants and an import function.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Handles the module import process, attempts to require a specified module, and falls back to local copies if needed.

search-terms: commonly used for dynamic module loading
